_description: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next — local Strata serve-layer deployment for agentic tool-calling workloads. Successor to qwen36 and to the 2026-09-20 GSQ-RCO llama.cpp deployment; the default local executor in UAP routing. Routes through the anthropic-proxy for the tool/finalize guardrails, NOT the inference server directly.
_engine: strata serve layer 0.1.60.1 on :8080, launched by the systemd user unit uap-strata-server.service with /home/cogtek/dev/strata/strata-abliterated-iq3_s.json (the DavidAU abliterated Turbo-Brilliance-50x GSQ-RCO IQ3_S default arm - REINSTATED the 2026-11-17 evening by operator follow-up after the morning ISTA switch; the exact set the fleet ran 2026-10-23 -> 2026-10-28; the ISTA base IQ3_S stays installed switchable as strata-base-iq3s, unit uap-strata-base-iq3s-server.service; switch/revert: ~/.config/uap/model-switch.sh strata|strata-base-iq3s). Serves llama.cpp-shaped /props, /slots and /v1, plus a JSON /metrics (engine/live/requests - NOT Prometheus text; `uap inference health` auto-detects it). Weights: strata-data pack abliterated-iq3_s + models/abliterated-IQ3_S GGUFs (HF DavidAU/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Abliterated-Uncensored-Turbo-Brilliance-50x-Reasoning-Instruct-GSQ-RCO-GGUF at the registry-pinned rev 623b419b; shard 1 sha256-verified against the Hub LFS oid at the reinstatement; shard 2 is the tier-shared PLE n-gram table, byte-identical across the GSQ-RCO tiers, hardlinked from the live ISTA base copy, zero re-download; mmproj reused, sha-identical across the release) with MTP speculative drafts (spec 12, spec-min-p 0.70, mtp_max 8 - live /metrics 2026-11-17: spec window 12, mtp_max 8, spec_min_p 0.70, drafting mtp), int8 KV resident 32768, 40 GiB resident expert budget + SSD streaming for the rest, PLE table SSD-backed, 196608 pool (the #918 raise), mmproj vision on CPU. The ENGINE A/B pair: uap-speedy-server (the Speedy 0.4.7 fork, engine line 0.1.53) serves the SAME DavidAU set via /home/cogtek/dev/speedy/speedy-abliterated-iq3_s.json and advertises qwen3.8-flash-next-speedy-abliterated-iq3_s - the engine is the only variable between the arms. Model id advertised at /v1/models: abliterated-iq3_s; the server ignores requested model ids entirely, which is why stale client pins (e.g. a resumed session still naming the ISTA or v31 ids) keep working.

That unit is now INACTIVE — the box serves the Strata layer on :8080 instead (tuned 2026-10-03: +15% over the llama.cpp fork on agent workloads). The old description was itself a 2026-09-20 correction of a ninfer-serve description. Verify against /metrics before trusting engine claims here; the dead unit's ExecStart still reports -c 229376 to systemctl, and on 2026-10-04 `uap inference health` printed that stale pool size for the live (131072) backend.

The server ignores requested model ids, so clients pinning the old id are unaffected; on revert, restore this field alongside the unit's --config. 2026-10-28: the unit default moved to the DavidAU abliterated IQ2_XS arm (uap-strata-server -> strata-abliterated-iq2_xs.json), so the live alias is abliterated-iq2_xs; updated here the same day the rails drift-check caught it. 2026-11-11: the default arm moved to the pristine Unsloth Dynamic v3.1 UD-IQ4_XS base quant (uap-strata-server -> strata-unsloth-ud-iq4_xs-v31.json), so the live alias was qwen3.8-flash-next-unsloth-ud-iq4_xs-v31. 2026-11-13: the operator switched the fleet to the abliterated arm (panel switch to uap-strata-abliterated-server.service), so the live alias was abliterated-iq2_xs; updated here the same day the rails drift-check caught it. 2026-11-14: the operator reverted to the v31 arm (uap-strata-server.service active again, the abliterated unit dead; live /v1/models advertises qwen3.8-flash-next-unsloth-ud-iq4_xs-v31), so the live alias is back to the v31 id; updated here the same day the rails drift-check caught it. 2026-11-17: the operator switched the fleet to the ISTA-DASLab base GSQ-RCO IQ3_S arm (uap-strata-server -> strata-iq3_s.json, same-day removal of the other flash-next quants), so the live alias is qwen3.8-flash-next-gsq-rco-iq3_s — deliberately NOT the historical qwen3.8-flash-next-iq3_s, which stays in the registry's retired_local_aliases; updated here the same day, verified against live /v1/models + /props. 2026-11-17 (evening): the operator's same-day follow-up reinstated the DavidAU abliterated TB-50x GSQ-RCO IQ3_S arm as the default (uap-strata-server -> strata-abliterated-iq3_s.json, the exact set the fleet ran 2026-10-23 -> 2026-10-28; the ISTA base stays switchable as strata-base-iq3s), so the live alias is abliterated-iq3_s - un-retired from retired_local_aliases in the same round; updated here the same day, verified against live /v1/models + /props.
_max_tokens_comment: Deliberately generous: 50% of the 180224 window, the same ratio the 57344/114688 and 65536/131072 pairings before it used. The engine returns chain-of-thought in a SEPARATE reasoning_content field, so reasoning spends completion budget without ever appearing in content. A tight cap therefore does not produce a short answer, it produces an EMPTY one with finish_reason=length — measured previously as ~90% first-turn decode failure that read as bad output format and was really budget truncation. Do not lower this without re-measuring decode compliance. (The proxy additionally clamps tool turns to PROXY_TOOL_TURN_MAX_TOKENS=32768 regardless.)
_sampling_comment: Carried over from qwen36 unchanged: these are UAP's tool-call-tuned values, not the vendor's chat defaults. They were re-measured only against the llama.cpp GSQ-RCO engine, never against strata — strata's own defaults (spec 12, spec-min-p 0.5) affect drafting, not base sampling, so the values are carried as-is. Re-tune with `uap tune` before changing them.
_context_window_comment: THIS IS A PER-SESSION CAP, AND IT IS LOAD-BEARING. Strata serves ONE rail with a 196608-cell pool (--max-context 196608 since 2026-11-17, the engine's native max_model_len; SSD-backed PLE pages KV beyond the 32768 resident cells); the proxy's detection reads slots[0].n_ctx and would otherwise tell every session it owns the whole pool. 180224 deliberately sits BELOW the pool: the difference (16384 cells, the same engine-margin convention the 114688/131072 pairing used) is the engine's own working room (prompt scratch, conversation cache, expert-cache bookkeeping), so a session at the cap cannot crowd the engine out of its own pool. Admission stays 1: two hot sessions at this cap would demand 360448 cells from a 196608-cell pool, the exact overcommit the per-session cap exists to prevent. In practice sessions sit below it: the proxy prunes at 0.80 (~144k) toward 0.70 (~126k) — the operator band for the 180224 posture (the 114688 era ran 0.92 toward 0.80); the compaction invariant in test/model-profiles-qwen38-rails.test.ts pins the band that ships with THIS window. IMPORTANT GAP (unchanged from the llama.cpp era): this cap is OPT-IN. A client that does not send the x-uap-model-profile header gets the whole pool. opencode, codex and claude-local send it; factory/droid custom models cannot, so keep factory to one local session at a time. /v1/models advertises the process-wide window (196608), not this cap.
_thinking_comment: Top-level. The proxy probes the backend once and adapts (PROXY_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS=auto|on|off), so the top-level enable_thinking form remains correct across both the llama.cpp and strata backends.

dynamic_temperature._comment: On retry, temp = max(floor, base_temp * decay^attempt). Reduces randomness for structured output.

tool_call_batching.system_prompt_suffix: When multiple tools are needed, call ALL of them in a single response. Do not call one tool and wait - emit all tool calls together.
tool_call_batching._comment: Reduces round-trips by encouraging multi-tool emission in one turn.

concurrency._comment: Strata runs ONE rail with a 196608-cell pool (raised from 131072 on 2026-11-17, operator-directed — the engine natively serves max_model_len 196608 and SSD-backed PLE pages KV beyond the resident cells; its predecessor ran two rails over 229376). One admitted hot session at the 180224 cap is all the pool can hold, so slots, proxy concurrency and session admission all stay 1 together — exactly the move-together rule the 2-rail comment below codified, in the opposite direction. scripts/sync-local-agent-configs.sh installs the matching PROXY_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT=1, UAP_MODEL_SLOTS=1, PROXY_SESSION_ADMISSION_LIMIT=1. Cost: a mission-deliver run queues behind opencode instead of overlapping; that is the accepted trade for the 180224 single-session window. NOTE the live proxy env is the authority until that script is run — the operator's 2026-11-17 admission=4 is a queue-depth override the full sync re-derives back to 1 (re-apply it after each sync, or land the per-profile threshold-override round that makes band and admission profile-owned).
concurrency._kv_shared_comment: One rail, one pool: trivially shared, and still true that a rail addresses the WHOLE pool rather than owning a slice. Kept true so consumers that branch on it keep treating the pool as a shared resource.

server_optimization._kv_dtype_comment: Fixed-tier int8 KV (8 bpv) with --kv-resident 32768, NOT the old VBR dynamic degrade — there is no floor to pin at, and the kv-at-floor finding no longer applies. Strata manages pool pressure itself (conversation cache eviction); the profile's job is only to keep the per-session cap below the pool.
server_optimization._capacity_comment: Whole pool, one rail (196608 since 2026-11-17). Per-session allowance is context_window above (180224, deliberately under the pool by the same 16384-cell engine margin).

speculative_decoding.draft_model: /home/cogtek/models/strata-data/mtp/rt (the model's own draft layer, shared with the other strata arms)
speculative_decoding._comment: 2026-11-17: the serving arm is the ISTA-DASLab base IQ3_S pack (strata-iq3_s.json), which drafts with the model's own MTP layer, pinned by "drafting": "mtp" in its config — live /metrics 2026-11-17: spec window 12, mtp_max 8, spec_min_p 0.70, lookup 3 (the v31 arm that served 2026-11-11 -> 2026-11-17 drafted at spec 12 / min-p 0.50 / mtp_max 4; the abliterated arm before that at 0.70 / mtp_max 8). The DFlash2 flip did NOT hold anywhere: the auto plan for this model class (spec 6 / conf 0.7, the tuned strata1 pack) OOM-killed the engine at start twice on 2026-11-11 and the serve wrapper's DIDNT_START fallback landed on MTP; sm_86 is also the card class where upstream measured DFlash2 slower than MTP (strata_control/drafting.py _SLOWER) and this box's own 2026-10-28 A/B rejected the stock drafter (-5.5% mean decode, bench/results/2026-10-28-dflash2-vs-mtp). A DFlash2 retry needs a smaller RAM budget and a fresh measured A/B — it stays documentation, never a live value here. The 2026-10-04 acceptance figure in `measured` predates every drafter here: re-measure on real agent traffic before quoting a number.

server_optimization._comment: These are the flags run-iq3_xxs.sh actually runs strata with, recorded so a rebuild reproduces the measured behaviour. The load-bearing pair (kv int8, max-context 196608) is pinned in config/capacity-policy.json under the strata-server http entry, where `uap doctor` verifies them against /metrics.

measured._arm_comment: The figures below were measured 2026-10-04 on the pre-arm-swap strata base pack (IQ3_S-era weights). The 2026-11-11 move to the unsloth UD-IQ4_XS v3.1 arm, the 2026-11-13 switch to the abliterated arm and the 2026-11-14 revert to the v31 arm all keep the engine, the 131072 pool and the int8 KV tier, so they carry as estimates; the drafting numbers differ per arm (v31: spec 12 / 0.50 / mtp_max 4; abliterated: spec 12 / 0.70 / mtp_max 8 — recorded in server_optimization), and decode/acceptance on THIS arm were never re-measured (uap tune / scripts/bench-decode-reps.sh) before quoting them as its figures. 2026-11-17: the ISTA-DASLab base IQ3_S arm (drafting spec 12 / 0.70 / mtp_max 8, recorded in server_optimization) keeps the engine, pool and KV tier too — switch-day smoke only (clean tool-call turn, ~60 tok/s cold first request, draft acceptance 42/65 = 0.65 cold, warming); no formal re-measure on it yet. 2026-11-17 (evening): the operator-directed pool raise to 196608 (per-session window 180224) changes neither the engine nor the KV tier, so these figures carry as estimates unchanged; KV beyond the 32768 resident cells pages via SSD-backed PLE exactly as it already did beyond 131072. 2026-11-17 (evening): the DavidAU abliterated IQ3_S arm REINSTATED as the default (same engine, same 196608 pool, int8 KV; drafting spec 12 / 0.70 / mtp_max 8 unchanged) - figures still carry as estimates; decode/acceptance never re-measured on this arm either.
measured._gpu_comment: Strata's own reserve-aware /metrics reported ~950 MiB free under live load (--vram-reserve-mib 1200 already held out; arena 40925 MiB across host+device, expert cache ~14.5 GiB). Host-wide free via nvidia-smi is the doctor's number; engine.vram_free_mib is strata's view, and both are checked now.
measured._decode_comment: CODE GENERATION on real agent traffic, observed 2026-10-04 over the live session: 41.5-51.6 tok/s at 19-20k prompt depth, 36.6 at 38.6k depth, 43.2-47.4 in the 11-12k range, one 45.9 sustained across a 7071-token generation. Depth matters as much as workload: 47 here is a mid-depth code-workload number, not a constant. Do not quote a decode number without saying which workload and what depth.
measured._draft_acceptance_comment: Agent-tool workloads observed 2026-10-04: 84-89% per request (80/93, 66/77, 91/110, 4535/5427 tokens) with one 62% outlier on a 311-token short generation. The prior engine's counting-prompt 0.90 remained dishonest; this figure is from real agent traffic only.
measured._prefill_comment: Observed 2026-10-04 on live traffic: 900-1025 tok/s reading 3.7-11.6k unique tokens per turn (with 15.5k+ reused from the conversation cache at 95-99% reuse). Strata reports read-rate only on non-reused tokens, same convention as the old profile.
measured._concurrency_comment: Moot at one rail: there is no second rail to measure. Kept null so no concurrent-throughput claim survives from the 2-rail era.

routing._comment: Route through the anthropic-proxy, NOT the strata port directly — the proxy applies the tool/finalize guardrails and, via this profile, the per-session context window that clients size their history to. Clients select this profile with the header 'x-uap-model-profile: qwen38' (or a uap_model_profile body param).
